scope: Prose and structured-planning documents from registered Mermaid Roshan worktrees and documents changed since October 31 in recent separately published branches, excluding documents already represented by the reconciled candidate. Each snapshot retains its draft or source-only status. Original workspaces and source branches are retained.
payload_hash_method: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 lines: sha256 + two spaces + relative payload path + LF
source_terms: Project document snapshots preserve original text, attribution and source-specific terms. Review status follows each source record.

packaging.method: Separate ZIPs containing whole original document snapshots
packaging.result: Every volume passes the existing archive inspector
